asked: # Build: molly-console-commands (Current profile) - URGENT bug fix ## Brett said (verbatim, Nov 3 2026, voice) "I mean Molly. I'm in control through Molly." (after Amber's console_settings / console_open commands never reached his screen while he was using the Console inside Molly in Chrome) Assigned agent: whoever is free (router if on main; else **Ping Paulie**; record who). Register in the `current` profile (id `molly-console-commands`) + banner entry. Fix right away, tell after. ## Bug Amber drives the Dev Console through the axf-console MCP (console_open / console_settings / console_dialog / console_action, console-commands PR #249). When Brett uses the Console embedded in **Molly** (apps/molly, xLayout frames, embed@), commands are 'sent' to clients cc-bbtoklptl9ke / cc-iw5fg6x8lm1f but 'the console didn't answer within 4 s' - nothing happens on his screen even though Chrome is in front. Likely: the embedded console frame's command socket is throttled/asleep as a background iframe, or the embedded console registers as a client but Molly blocks/doesn't relay the command, or auth/token differs inside the frame, or Molly shows a cached/inactive frame. ## Fix - s1 Reproduce with a headless browser loading Molly with the Console frame; trace the console-command@1 path. - s2 Make commands work inside Molly: either the embedded console's socket stays live and executes, or Molly itself registers as the console client and relays console-command@1 to the right frame via embed@ (bringing that frame to the front, then running it). Report the client as `app: molly/console-web` so console_clients shows it clearly. Commands addressed to 'recent' go to the client Brett is actually looking at (visibility/focus wins over lastUsed). - s3 Same for the axHub and AmberX frames inside Molly where they accept commands. - s4 console-wake (#266) path: if Molly is the open app, wake/relay through Molly instead of opening a separate console tab. - s5 Tests (command reaches embedded console; focus picks the visible client), report `_claude/builds/reports/molly-console-commands.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Merge when green and redeploy (Brett needs this to use voice control); still file UI Review if UI changed. Commits clean and professional. ## Addendum 1 (Brett, Nov 3 2026, voice) Brett said (verbatim): "Add all the apps to the API and the MCP and the CLI. So Molly, you can control Molly." - Every app on the framework gets the same control surface the Console has (control@1 + plugin-commands-auto: REST + MCP + CLI generated from declared commands): **Molly** (open/switch/close app frames, layouts/presets, dock panes, nav items, banners, its settings, which app is in front, screenshots of what's on screen), **axHub web** (screens, approvals, services, settings), **AmberX** web/app shell (screens, notes/tasks, listener, settings; native-only actions via the AXPP device link), and any future app automatically (the framework template/boilerplate ships the control surface so new apps get it by default). - One MCP entry point: either extend the axf-console MCP with app-scoped targets (`molly.*`, `axhub.*`, `amberx.*` alongside `console.*`) or register one MCP per app on axHub - pick the simpler that keeps tool names clear; navigation/read tools ALLOW policy, changes veto, deletes confirm. - `apps_list` read: every app, where it runs, connected clients, what's on screen now. - Commands addressed to an app inside Molly are relayed by Molly to that frame and bring it to the front. - Docs: interactive list in the Plugin commands page grouped by app. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault).
